summary: Tested 2 new features: (1) Certificate button text without (-18%) suffix, (2) Certificate history tracking and display in Statistics page. All 8 backend tests passed. Frontend tests confirmed all features working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created test order with certificateDiscount=true to verify logging (cleaned up after test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two features fully implemented and tested: 1) Certificate button text in calculator now shows 'Płatność certyfikatem' WITHOUT (-18%) suffix in Polish mode. 2) Certificate history tracking: when orders with certificateDiscount=true are created, they are logged to certificate_history collection. Statistics page (Statystyki tab) has CertificateHistorySection at the bottom with data-testid='certificate-history-section'. Section is collapsible, shows 'Brak historii certyfikatów' when empty, and displays table with columns: Data, Klient, Model, Cena przed rabatem, Cena po rabacie, Oszczędność, Menedżer when history exists.
